scenarios.name: Header and Navigation
scenarios.description: Verify the header section displays project identity with logo, tagline, and functional navigation links

steps.description: Navigate to the homepage URL
steps.context: User accessing the MirDB homepage for the first time

steps.description: Check that the MirDB logo (animated GIF) is visible and properly rendered
steps.context: Logo should be optimized for web delivery (<500KB)

steps.description: Confirm the tagline 'A Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Protocol' is displayed
steps.context: Tagline should clearly communicate product purpose

steps.description: Verify navigation links (Features, Architecture, Usage, GitHub) are present and functional
steps.context: Navigation should use anchor links for single-page scrolling

test_cases.expected: Page loads with header containing logo element with valid src attribute
Logo image exists with alt text and loads without error
Tagline text contains 'Persistent Key-Value Store' and 'Memcached'
Page scrolls to features section
Page scrolls to architecture section
Link points to https://github.com/yetone/mirdb

scenarios.name: Hero Section
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section prominently displays the key value proposition with clear call-to-action

steps.description: Navigate to the homepage URL
steps.context: User landing on the page should immediately see value proposition

steps.description: Check that the hero section clearly explains what MirDB does
steps.context: Should communicate memcached compatibility and persistence

steps.description: Confirm primary call-to-action button is present and styled prominently
Check that CircleCI build status badge is displayed
steps.context: Badge should link to CI pipeline

test_cases.expected: Hero section exists with headline describing MirDB value proposition
Primary CTA button exists with text 'Get Started' or 'View on GitHub'
Button navigates to appropriate section or external link
CircleCI badge image loads and links to https://circleci.com/gh/yetone/mirdb

scenarios.name: Features Section
scenarios.description: Verify the features section accurately displays MirDB capabilities with icons and descriptions

steps.description: Scroll or click to the features section of the homepage
steps.context: Section should be easily accessible from navigation

steps.description: Check that memcached protocol compatibility is highlighted
Check that LSM-tree based durability is explained
Check that skip list memtable and SSTable compaction are mentioned
Check that memory safety and performance benefits are communicated

test_cases.expected: Features section exists with id='features' or similar identifier
At least 4 feature items are displayed
Feature card exists mentioning memcached protocol compatibility
Feature card exists mentioning LSM-tree or persistence
Feature card mentions skip list, memtable, or SSTable
Feature card mentions Rust implementation

scenarios.name: Architecture Section
scenarios.description: Verify the architecture section displays component diagrams and technical explanations

steps.description: Scroll or click to the architecture section
steps.context: Section should contain technical details for evaluators

steps.description: Check that a high-level component diagram is present
Check that memtable with skip list is explained
Check that SSTable storage is explained
Check that Write-Ahead Log is mentioned
Check that minor and major compaction are explained

test_cases.expected: Architecture section exists with id='architecture' or similar
Section contains image, SVG, or Mermaid diagram element
Text mentioning memtable and skip list is present
Text mentioning SSTable or sorted string tables is present
Text mentioning WAL or write-ahead log is present
Text mentioning compaction (minor/major) is present

scenarios.name: Usage and Code Examples Section
scenarios.description: Verify the usage section provides code examples with syntax highlighting for memcached commands

steps.description: Scroll or click to the usage/examples section
steps.context: Section should help users get started quickly

steps.description: Check that code examples are present with syntax highlighting
steps.context: Should use Prism.js or similar highlighting

steps.description: Check that basic storage and retrieval commands are shown
Check for ADD, REPLACE, APPEND, PREPEND, DELETE examples
Check that code blocks have copy button

test_cases.expected: Usage section exists with id='usage' or similar
At least one <pre> or <code> element with syntax highlighting class exists
Code example containing SET command syntax is present
Code example containing GET command syntax is present

test_cases.input: Check for copy button on code blocks
test_cases.expected: Code blocks have copy-to-clipboard button or functionality
Code blocks have highlighting classes (e.g., language-bash, hljs)

scenarios.name: Project Status and Roadmap Section
scenarios.description: Verify the status section displays implemented features checklist and future roadmap

steps.description: Scroll or click to the status/roadmap section
Check that completed features are listed with checkmarks
steps.context: tokio, memtable, minor/major compaction should be checked

steps.description: Check that planned features are listed as unchecked
steps.context: Raft should be shown as planned

test_cases.expected: Status/roadmap section exists with appropriate id
Checklist or list element exists showing feature status
Tokio with memcached protocol is listed as completed
Memtable with skiplist is listed as completed
Minor and major compaction are listed as completed
Raft is listed as planned/not completed

scenarios.name: Footer and Links Section
scenarios.description: Verify the footer provides repository links, license info, and contribution guidelines

steps.description: Navigate to the bottom of the page
Check that GitHub repository link is present
Check that license information is displayed
Check for link to contribution guidelines

test_cases.expected: Footer element exists with appropriate semantic tag
Link to https://github.com/yetone/mirdb exists in footer

test_cases.input: Check for license text or link
test_cases.expected: License information is mentioned or linked
Link to issues, contributing guidelines, or discussions exists

scenarios.name: Responsive Design - Mobile
scenarios.description: Verify the homepage is fully functional and readable on mobile devices

steps.description: Resize browser to mobile dimensions (375px width)
Check that navigation becomes hamburger menu or stacks appropriately
Check that all text is readable without horizontal scrolling
Check that code blocks have horizontal scroll if needed
Verify all interactive elements work with touch

test_cases.expected: Page renders without horizontal overflow on body
Navigation is accessible (hamburger menu or collapsed)
Font size is at least 16px or readable on mobile
Code blocks have overflow-x: auto or scroll
Interactive elements are at least 44px tap target

scenarios.name: Responsive Design - Tablet
scenarios.description: Verify the homepage displays correctly on tablet-sized screens

steps.description: Resize browser to tablet dimensions (768px width)
Check that layout adjusts appropriately for tablet size
Check that features display in appropriate columns

test_cases.expected: Page renders with appropriate layout for tablet

test_cases.input: Check feature grid at tablet size
test_cases.expected: Features display in 2-column layout or similar
Navigation is usable and appropriately sized

scenarios.name: Accessibility Compliance
scenarios.description: Verify the homepage meets WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards

steps.description: Use automated tools to check accessibility
Verify all interactive elements are keyboard accessible
Verify text has sufficient contrast ratio
Verify all images have appropriate alt attributes
Verify proper heading structure (h1, h2, h3)

test_cases.expected: All links and buttons are reachable via keyboard
Focused elements have visible focus ring/outline
Logo image has alt='MirDB logo' or similar descriptive text
Text contrast ratio is at least 4.5:1 (AA standard)
Page has exactly one h1 element
Headings follow proper hierarchy (no skipped levels)

scenarios.name: Performance and Load Time
scenarios.description: Verify the homepage loads quickly and meets performance targets

steps.description: Load the page and measure time to interactive
Verify logo GIF is optimized (<500KB)
Execute Lighthouse performance audit
Verify minimal external dependencies

test_cases.expected: Page DOMContentLoaded in under 2 seconds on fast connection
Logo GIF is under 500KB
Lighthouse performance score is 90 or higher
No analytics or tracking scripts present (per NFR)
Total page size is under 1MB (excluding cached assets)

scenarios.name: Dark Mode Support
scenarios.description: Verify the homepage supports dark mode theme preference

steps.description: Configure OS/browser to prefer light color scheme
Check page renders appropriately in light mode
Configure OS/browser to prefer dark color scheme
Check page renders appropriately in dark mode
steps.context: Dark theme should be default per PRD

test_cases.expected: CSS includes @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) rules
Page renders with dark background and light text
Page renders with appropriate light theme

test_cases.input: Check code block contrast in dark mode
test_cases.expected: Code blocks remain readable in dark mode
